title: Distinguished Engineer Knowledge Library
subtitle: A working reference for the transition from Principal to Distinguished Engineer.
howTo: Read a volume end-to-end once, then return to its "What a DE Probes" and checklist sections before architecture reviews. The one-page refresher (Volume 22) condenses the entire map.

volumes.title: Distributed Systems
volumes.scope: Consensus, replication, partitioning, consistency models, time and ordering, failure taxonomy, idempotency, backpressure

volumes.title: Databases
volumes.scope: Storage engines (B-tree/LSM), WAL, MVCC, isolation levels, distributed SQL, sharding, replication topologies, query optimization

volumes.title: Networking
volumes.scope: TCP/QUIC, DNS, HTTP/2/3, proxies, L4/L7 load balancing, service mesh, CDN, failure analysis

volumes.title: Cloud & Infrastructure
volumes.scope: Kubernetes internals, container runtimes, compute/storage/network architecture, multi-region design

volumes.title: Capacity & Hardware Fundamentals
volumes.scope: CPU/memory hierarchy, NUMA, storage media, network hardware, latency numbers, where performance intuition comes from

volumes.title: Reliability Engineering
volumes.scope: SLO/SLA/SLI, error budgets, observability, incident management, graceful degradation, disaster recovery

volumes.title: Performance Engineering
volumes.scope: Latency decomposition, queueing theory, caching, concurrency, profiling, capacity modeling

volumes.title: Resilience Testing
volumes.scope: Chaos engineering, fault injection, DR game days, load testing at scale

volumes.title: Security Architecture
volumes.scope: Threat modeling, OAuth/OIDC, PKI/TLS, secrets management, IAM, zero trust, supply-chain security, cloud security

volumes.title: Privacy, Compliance & Data Protection
volumes.scope: PCI-DSS, CCPA/GDPR, data classification, retention, encryption at rest/in transit, audit

volumes.title: Data Architecture
volumes.scope: Streaming, Kafka, CDC, lakehouse, warehouses, governance, data contracts

volumes.title: AI Architecture
volumes.scope: LLM systems, agents, RAG, memory, evals, inference and model serving, safety and guardrails

volumes.title: Enterprise Architecture
volumes.scope: Platform boundaries, event architecture, build-vs-buy, migrations, legacy modernization

volumes.title: API & Contract Design
volumes.scope: Versioning, compatibility, REST/gRPC/GraphQL trade-offs, schema evolution, deprecation at scale

volumes.title: Platform Engineering & Developer Experience
volumes.scope: Paved roads, golden paths, internal platforms as products, DevEx metrics

volumes.title: Architecture Governance
volumes.scope: Standards, RFC/ADR processes, architecture review boards, platform strategy

volumes.title: FinOps
volumes.scope: Unit economics, cloud cost modeling, GPU economics, cost attribution and showback

volumes.title: Sociotechnical Architecture
volumes.scope: Conway's law, team topologies, cognitive load, org design as an architecture tool

volumes.title: Technical Leadership
volumes.scope: Influence without authority, resolving architectural disagreements, mentoring Principals, DE operating models

volumes.title: Executive Communication
volumes.scope: Compressing a 40-page problem into a 5-minute decision, writing for VPs, narrative memos

volumes.title: Technology Strategy
volumes.scope: Spotting technology shifts; adopt / ignore / experiment frameworks; horizon planning

volumes.title: The One-Page Refresher
volumes.scope: Printable distillation of the entire map, built after all volumes are complete
